page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, utilizing the x86_64 AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at 2.55 GHz. The instance is configured with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPUs, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.r7a.16xlarge demonstrates strong performance in several key areas. Its CPU capabilities are highlighted by top-tier results in stress-ng single-core and multi-core tests, as well as Passmark CPU score, extended instructions, and encryption tests. Memory subsystem performance is strong for cached small-block read-only operations, though uncached large-block read and write bandwidth falls into the average category. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, ray tracing, and image processing benchmarks also rank in the top 25 percent, while software compilation, database operations, and Redis SET operations perform at average levels.

The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which may impact workloads requiring high-speed local disk I/O. However, the high memory density and dedicated CPU allocation make this instance highly cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads that do not require GPU acceleration. It is well-suited for large-scale in-memory databases, data caching layers, multi-threaded data processing, and small-scale LLM inference tasks.
